title: Radiostanice R-105d — Czechoslovak (ČSLA, Tesla Pardubice) man-pack VHF FM radio station, metal-cased R-105/R-105D family
era: Soviet R-105 family (1960s); R-105D = modernized R-105 with a built-in retranslation (relay) unit; licence-built for the ČSLA by Tesla Pardubice with a Czech-language (Latin) control panel — NOT Cyrillic. 36.0–46.1 MHz, 1–1.2 W FM, carried on the back with a webbing harness.

sources.valka: https://www.valka.cz/SOV-R-105-108-109-114-prenosna-radiostanica-t38027 — radio unit 310×170×325 mm; working set ~20.5 kg; grey rough-enamel front panel; Czech control inventory
sources.radiomuseum: https://www.radiomuseum.org/r/b_8865_r_105m_p_105m.html — R-105M 170×325×310 mm (W×H×D); same body envelope as R-105D
sources.army_surplus: https://www.army-surplus.cz/radiova-stanice-r-105d-csla-original/ — R-105d ČSLA original ~37×17,5×35 cm; bare transceiver ~13 kg; licence-built Tesla Pardubice; sold without straps/belt/antenna
sources.feldfunker: https://feldfunker-la7sna.com/radio_r105d.htm — aluminium-alloy chassis & covers, painted 'Telegreen'; AŠ-1,5 Kulikov whip 1.5 m; back cushion + canvas straps; ~21 kg working
sources.ruwiki: https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/Р-105Д — 36–46.1 MHz, 203 channels; Cyrillic panel on Soviet issue (AVOID)
sources.vu9967: https://www.vu9967.cz/technika/radiove-stanice/radiove-stanice-typu-astra — Czech control inventory & verbatim Czech panel labels; confirms Latin (Czech) script, not Cyrillic
sources.photos_local: ref/Untitled2.png + ref/tschechoslowakei-*~2.jpg (Czech R-105d front panel, all labels legible) · ref/tschechoslowakei-*~6.jpg (CLOSED lid: stamped X-cross + centre boss) · ref/tschechoslowakei-*~8.jpg (rounded corner guards + stencilled serial '320065') · ref/6086bfa133e46e93a984bf2035adde9f.jpg (deployed straight telescopic whip on a BRASS base + black headset cable arc) · ref/how-was-this-r105d-radio-worn-*.jpg (back harness: tan canvas straps, leather keepers, waist strap, on the large side face) · ref/r105d1.jpg & ref/s-l1200.jpg (Soviet Р-105Д/М Cyrillic variants — AVOID)

body_dims.quote: 170 × 325 × 310 mm (W×H×D); corroborated '310×170×325' by valka & greenradio; army_surplus ~175×350×370
body_dims.note: narrow upright metal case; the grey control panel + its hinged lid are on the FRONT narrow face (170 W × 325 H); 310 deep. The carry harness is on a LARGE side face (depth×height ≈ 310×325). Worn on the back.

mass_kg.quote: bare transceiver ~13 kg; ~20.5–21 kg working set (valka, feldfunker, ruwiki)

materials.quote: aluminium-alloy chassis & covers, 'Telegreen' green paint (feldfunker); grey rough-enamel front panel (valka); ČSLA Tesla Pardubice (army_surplus)

antenna.construction: deployed it stands as a near-straight telescopic/segmented whip of decreasing-diameter sections rising from a prominent BRASS knurled base + nut on top of the case; the large black rubber ARC over the top is the headset/handset cable, NOT the antenna
antenna.mount: brass knurled base screwed to the antenna socket on top of the case toward the panel/front edge (no spring base)
antenna.quote: АШ-1,5 1.5 m whip; ref/6086bfa133e46e93a984bf2035adde9f.jpg shows the straight telescopic whip on a brass base, with the separate black headset cable arcing from a top-left connector

harness.layout: plastic-covered back cushion/pad against the operator + two canvas (webbing) shoulder straps each held by TWO reddish-brown leather keeper loops + a waist strap with buckles; clips to lugs on the case edges; mounted on a LARGE side face
harness.colour: khaki/tan cotton webbing, reddish-brown leather keepers
harness.quote: back cushion + canvas straps (feldfunker); ref/how-was-this-r105d-radio-worn-*.jpg shows tan webbing shoulder straps with 2 leather keepers each, a waist strap, on the big side face

top_face.layout: brass knurled antenna base (toward the front/panel edge) with the telescopic whip rising from it; a leather carry handle (centre); a brass headset connector (top-left) with the black rubber cable arcing from it; side lever clasps on the right edge, hinges on the left

lid_face.layout: the closed front lid (door) is a stamped steel sheet carrying TWO diagonal raised ribs forming an X corner-to-corner, with a raised circular boss where they cross; riveted perimeter; hinged on the left edge, two lever clasps on the right. The case's four vertical corners carry MASSIVE rounded corner-guard rails (not thin rods). A white spray-stencilled serial (e.g. '320065') sits on a case face.
lid_face.quote: ref/tschechoslowakei-*~6.jpg (closed lid X-cross + centre boss) and ~8.jpg (rounded corner guards + stencil '320065')

power_switch.layout: a LARGE round black rotary power knob accessible on the closed case (lower-left of the front face), with white stencilled 'VYP' (vypnuto = off, upper) and 'ZAP' (zapnuto = on, lower) labels to its right
power_switch.quote: ref/zap.png — hand turning the big black VYP/ZAP knob on the X-cross face, lid clasp at the right edge

panel_layout.layout: behind the lid: tall grey panel with LADĚNÍ ANTÉNY, NASTAVENÍ KMITOČTU, ARETACE STUPNICE, round tuning-scale window, DÁLK. OVLÁD. A RETRANSLACE selector, ANT. PROUD/NAPĚTÍ AKU V-meter, white blank plate, red 'POZOR! NEPŘÍTEL NASLOUCHÁ', KALIBRÁTOR STISKNOUT, nameplate 'R-105d'. The lid's inner face carries 'NÁVOD K OBSLUZE RÁDIOVÉ STANICE'. (For the OPEN version, later.)
panel_layout.quote: ref/Untitled2.png, ref/tschechoslowakei-*~2.jpg — all Czech labels legible

feature_layout_m.value: sub-features placed by proportional reading of the reference photos against the 170 mm panel width / 310 mm depth
feature_layout_m.formula: feature_pos = (pixel offset / reference pixel size) × body dimension
feature_layout_m.note: honest photo-proportional placement of sub-features; no invented absolute sub-dimensions
